scope: Six world-drop materials, canonical single-tier normalization. No first-person, icon, collision, balance or heat changes.
dimensions_note: Original 128px icon silhouettes bound mesh X/Z; native actor Scale .25 and existing Radius/Height remain authoritative.
modularity: Each rock and inset opaque undercoat is a separate closed editable OBJ group; these are prop components, not wearable equipment.
projection_note: Original pixels project onto faceted rock protrusions, joined behind their faces by a core using the largest opaque rectangular crop of the same icon. Inset sampled undercoats close alpha gaps. Coal red paint is non-emissive artwork only.
